summary: The change clears stale in-flight create work when preparation persistence rejects, allowing the same operation ID to retry without reminting or losing the cached material preparation. No actionable defect was found in the committed change.

evidence: src/authority/native-authority-principals.ts:600-605 clears the cached in-flight work when commit.prepare() throws, so a later create with the same operation ID starts preparation again rather than awaiting the failed state.

src/authority/native-authority-principals.ts:266-270 retains the cached CreateFlight preparation fields (token, time, defaults, hash, pricing, ID, prepared record), preserving material binding and duplicate coalescing across the retry.
The supplied preparation-failure regression remains present in tests/fixtures/native-authority/principal-control-cases.mjs P25 and is unaffected by the source-only change.
